crew.overview: In a countryside town bordering on a magical land, a young man makes a promise to his beloved that he'll retrieve a fallen star by venturing into the magical realm. His journey takes him into a world beyond his wildest dreams and reveals his true identity.

crew.overview: In 18th century France, Marquise de Merteuil asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned.
crew.title: Dangerous Liaisons

crew.overview: Jamie Graham, a privileged English boy, is living in Shanghai when the Japanese invade and force all foreigners into prison camps. Jamie is captured with an American sailor, who looks out for him while they are in the camp together. Even though he is separated from his parents and in a hostile environment, Jamie maintains his dignity and youthful spirit, providing a beacon of hope for the others held captive with him.

details.biography:
Gavin Bocquet is a British production designer.

He studied product design at Newcastle Polytechnic before earning a Master of Design from the Royal College of Art in 1979. Bocquet began his film career as an art department draftsman on The Elephant Man (1980) and Return of the Jedi (1983). Four years later, he advanced to assistant art director on Return to Oz (1985) and Young Sherlock Holmes (1985). By the time he worked on Empire of the Sun (1987), he had become a full-fledged art director. His other art direction credits include Dangerous Liaisons (1988), Erik the Viking (1989), and Cry Freedom (1987), where he had the opportunity to collaborate with Stuart Craig, whom—along with Norman Reynolds—he considers a mentor.

Transitioning to production design, Bocquet worked on the British television series Yellowthread Street and the American series The Young Indiana Jones Chronicles, earning one Emmy Award and two nominations. His feature film credits as a production designer include Kafka (1991) and Radioland Murders (1994).
